tools.name: list_signs
tools.description: Lists EntryPing printable sign makers (closed, out to lunch, holiday closings, out of order, meeting in progress, QR code signs and more) with each one's default wording. Pass a few words to narrow the list.

tools.name: make_sign_link
tools.description: Returns a link that opens an EntryPing sign maker with the wording already filled in. The person can edit every line and preview free; printing and PDF export require EntryPing Pro. Nothing is saved.
